scope: Automated JavaScript engine and application tests with a lightweight DOM stub. Not a real-browser, mobile or student pilot test.

tests.name: Complete application initializes with Kazakh as the default
Valid light circuit validates, starts, stops and resumes
Light 290 ON, 300 OFF and 310 OFF; once-only result recording
Invalid output GPIO prevents simulation and explains in Kazakh
Unknown pin, ADC mismatch, duplicate pin and DHT input-only rejection
Editing a validated or completed circuit invalidates simulation and result
Restart resets observations and sensor value; completed restart starts new attempt
Component removal invalidates, then re-add and rewire runs again
Temperature 27 and 28 OFF, 29 ON
Motion false OFF, true ON, false OFF
Non-finite sensor input is ignored; out-of-range input is clamped
Language switching preserves running circuit and observations
Exam helper locked; attempt saved only on finish, then immutable
PC office, gaming and workstation produce correct POST and once-only records
PC socket, DDR, cooling, PSU and task conditions are validated
PC edit after a saved result produces a new attempt ID
Per-attempt student code, date and check result persist across reload
Blocked storage keeps records in memory and displays warning
JSON export and duplicate import round-trip without changing own progress
Invalid JSON, oversized files, invalid scores and conflicting IDs are rejected atomically
Untrusted names render escaped and CSV formula cells are neutralized
Report draft saves, exports with the attempt and rejects oversized values
All six bilingual lessons have no unresolved translation keys; exam omits steps
All HTML assets are local and present, and every script parses
